[SWS_CRYPT_04205]
{DRAFT}
Importing public objects
⌈
The function
ara::
crypto::cryp::CryptoProvider::ImportPublicObject
shall deserialize the
provided serialized data and save the contained CryptoObject to the persistent or
volatile storage represented by the provided IOInterface. The function shall return
•
kUnexpectedValue
if the payload (serialized CryptoObject and associated
meta-data) contains invalid data.
•
kBadObjectType
if the contained CryptoObject does not match the provided
exptected CryptoObjectType.
•
kInsufficientCapacity
if the capacity of the underlying resource pointed to
by the provided IOInterface is insufficient to hold the deserialized CryptoObject.
•
kUnreservedResource
if the IOInterface is not opened writable.
⌋
(RS_CRYPTO_02004)
